verdict.rationale: Zulip supports bots that run autonomously in the background via its bot API framework and Botserver for production deployment, plus a full REST/OpenAPI API and CLI tools for scripting automations. However, this is a general chatbot/integration framework rather than an AI-native agentic automation platform with built-in scheduling, triggers, or autonomous task orchestration. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-specific agent orchestration, native scheduling/triggering beyond message-reactive bots, and independent hands-on validation that bots run reliably unattended in production.
